nodes.label: Soft Delete
nodes.description: Data deletion strategy using deleted_at timestamp instead of hard deletes for users and products.

nodes.label: UUID Primary Keys
nodes.description: All database tables use UUID primary keys for better security and distributed system support.

nodes.label: Database Normalization
nodes.description: Avoid duplicate data, follow normalization principles, do not store same info in multiple tables.

nodes.label: Database Guidelines
nodes.description: Database architecture, design principles, naming conventions, relationships, and data management rules.

nodes.label: Table Plural snake_case
nodes.description: Table names must be plural, lowercase, snake_case (e.g., users, products, order_items).

nodes.label: Column snake_case
nodes.description: All columns must use lowercase snake_case (e.g., first_name, created_at).

nodes.label: Foreign Keys Required
nodes.description: Always use foreign keys for relationships to protect data integrity.

nodes.label: Migrations Required
nodes.description: Every database structure change must use Alembic migrations; never manually modify production databases.
